channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: GAC GN8 PHEV Executive pairs VIP comfort with 1,000-km range
item.description: GAC Philippines is putting comfort at the center of its flagship people mover with the GN8 PHEV Executive, a seven-seat plug-in hybrid MPV designed for customers who spend long hours on the road. item.description: ACMobility subsidiary Greenstrum and Huawei Technologies Philippines have introduced battery storage and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions to businesses seeking to manage electricity costs and prepare their properties for electric mobility. item.title: VF 3 Wins Consumer Award
item.description: VinFast’s VF 3 has received the “Trusted & Popular Brand 2026” award in the Passenger Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) category at the Disway Awards 2026 in Indonesia, after recording the highest consumer awareness in its category. item.title: Geely Monjaro EM-i earns Guinness record
item.description: Geely’s Monjaro EM-i plug-in hybrid SUV has earned a Guinness World Records title after completing a 188.6-kilometer crossing of Egypt’s Black and White Deserts in the Sahara, ahead of its Philippine introduction.

item.title: Suzuki Phl brings its ‘By Your Side’ promise closer to Batangas City
item.description: New 3S Satellite dealership expands Suzuki’s presence and brings sales, service, and genuine parts closer to customers

item.title: Honda teaches road safety in 11 schools
item.description: More than 380 students aged 16 and older, along with some faculty members, took part in a road safety education program conducted by Honda Foundation Inc. (HFI) across 11 public schools in Santa Rosa City, Laguna.

item.title: MINI wears Paul Smith again
item.description: MINI has renewed its partnership with British fashion designer Paul Smith through a special edition of the all-electric Cooper SE, now available in Singapore.

item.title: Porsche opens Singapore track bookings
item.description: Porsche has opened reservations for its upcoming Porsche Experience Centre Singapore, where visitors can book driving sessions from April 2027, ahead of the facility’s official opening in Changi.

item.title: Green SM doubles Sumatra presence
item.description: Electric taxi operator Green SM has expanded its operations in Indonesia with the launch of its service in Palembang, the second city in Sumatra to welcome the company after Bandar Lampung.

item.title: MG 4 EV Urban vs Geely EX2: Spec battle
item.description: Aussies have never been more spoilt for choice when it comes to small electric hatchbacks. We compare two of the newest examples in a head-to-head bench test.

item.title: The Future Of DS Looks Very Bright Thanks To The F3VER Concept
item.description: The DS F3VER is based on the company's "Design Intelligence" approach and definitely looks the part

item.title: Chase Briscoe Holds off JGR Teammate in Closest Finish of NASCAR Season
item.description: Chase Briscoe beat his Joe Gibbs Racing teammate Christopher Bell to the line by 0.029 seconds, the closest margin of the season.
